-- l.2-12, verbatim. MONEY_ICON_WIDTH = 19 MONEY_ICON_WIDTH_SMALL = 13
MONEY_BUTTON_SPACING = -4 MONEY_BUTTON_SPACING_SMALL = -4
COPPER_PER_SILVER = 100 SILVER_PER_GOLD = 100 COPPER_PER_GOLD = COPPER_PER_SILVER * SILVER_PER_GOLD
COIN_BUTTON_WIDTH = 32
-- l.14-103: the money TYPES. A money frame carries no amount of its own — it carries a type, -- and the type says where to read the number from (`UpdateFunc`, called with `this` set to the -- frame), whether zero denominations collapse away, whether the smaller coins show anyway, and -- whether the coins are click-to-pick-up. Addons read this table directly, so its shape is the -- contract, not just its behaviour. MoneyTypeInfo = { } MoneyTypeInfo["PLAYER"] = { UpdateFunc = function() -- Reference l.17: `GetMoney() - GetCursorMoney() - GetPlayerTradeMoney()`. The -- cursor term is dropped, not approximated: `GetCursorMoney` is the amount lifted onto -- the cursor by the coin-pickup frame, and benilla ships neither that frame nor the -- `PickupPlayerMoney` verb behind it, so it is structurally 0 here. The term returns -- the moment either lands. return GetMoney() - GetPlayerTradeMoney() end,
PickupFunc = function(amount) PickupPlayerMoney(amount) end,
DropFunc = function() DropCursorMoney() end,
collapse = 1, canPickup = 1, showSmallerCoins = "Backpack" } MoneyTypeInfo["STATIC"] = { UpdateFunc = function() return this.staticMoney end,
collapse = 1, } MoneyTypeInfo["AUCTION"] = { UpdateFunc = function() return this.staticMoney end, showSmallerCoins = "Backpack", fixedWidth = 1, collapse = 1, truncateSmallCoins = nil, } MoneyTypeInfo["PLAYER_TRADE"] = { UpdateFunc = function() return GetPlayerTradeMoney() end,
PickupFunc = function(amount) PickupTradeMoney(amount) end,
DropFunc = function() AddTradeMoney() end,
collapse = 1, canPickup = 1, } MoneyTypeInfo["TARGET_TRADE"] = { UpdateFunc = function() return GetTargetTradeMoney() end,
collapse = 1, } MoneyTypeInfo["SEND_MAIL"] = { UpdateFunc = function() -- `GetSendMailMoney` (ref l.73) is an engine verb we have not built — see the header. if not GetSendMailMoney then return 0 end return GetSendMailMoney() end,
PickupFunc = function(amount) PickupSendMailMoney(amount) end,
DropFunc = function() AddSendMailMoney() end,
collapse = nil, canPickup = 1, showSmallerCoins = "Backpack", } MoneyTypeInfo["SEND_MAIL_COD"] = { UpdateFunc = function() -- `GetSendMailCOD` (ref l.90) — same gap as SEND_MAIL above. if not GetSendMailCOD then return 0 end return GetSendMailCOD() end,
PickupFunc = function(amount) PickupSendMailCOD(amount) end,
DropFunc = function() AddSendMailCOD() end,
collapse = 1, canPickup = 1, }
-- l.105-122: the two OnLoads. Identical but for `this.small`, which is what picks the 13px -- coin + tight spacing over the 19px one in MoneyFrame_Update below. Both then take type -- PLAYER, so a frame that is never told otherwise shows the purse. function MoneyFrame_OnLoad() this:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") this:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_TRADE_MONEY") this:RegisterEvent("TRADE_MONEY_CHANGED") this:RegisterEvent("SEND_MAIL_MONEY_CHANGED") this:RegisterEvent("SEND_MAIL_COD_CHANGED") MoneyFrame_SetType("PLAYER") end
function SmallMoneyFrame_OnLoad() this:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") this:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_TRADE_MONEY") this:RegisterEvent("TRADE_MONEY_CHANGED") this:RegisterEvent("SEND_MAIL_MONEY_CHANGED") this:RegisterEvent("SEND_MAIL_COD_CHANGED") this.small = 1 MoneyFrame_SetType("PLAYER") end
-- l.124-140, verbatim: every money frame hears every money event, and each decides for itself -- whether the one that arrived is about the number IT is showing. function MoneyFrame_OnEvent() if ( not this.info or not this:IsVisible() ) then return end
if ( event == "PLAYER_MONEY" and this.moneyType == "PLAYER" ) then MoneyFrame_UpdateMoney() elseif ( event == "PLAYER_TRADE_MONEY" and (this.moneyType == "PLAYER" or this.moneyType == "PLAYER_TRADE") ) then MoneyFrame_UpdateMoney() elseif ( event == "TRADE_MONEY_CHANGED" and this.moneyType == "TARGET_TRADE" ) then MoneyFrame_UpdateMoney() elseif ( event == "SEND_MAIL_MONEY_CHANGED" and (this.moneyType == "PLAYER" or this.moneyType == "SEND_MAIL") ) then MoneyFrame_UpdateMoney() elseif ( event == "SEND_MAIL_COD_CHANGED" and (this.moneyType == "PLAYER" or this.moneyType == "SEND_MAIL_COD") ) then MoneyFrame_UpdateMoney() end end
-- l.142-162: point a frame at a money type. Operates on `this`, not on a passed frame — the -- reference's convention here, and what the eleven corpus callers write. function MoneyFrame_SetType(type) local info = MoneyTypeInfo[type] if ( not info ) then -- ref l.145 `message("Invalid money type: "..type)` — `message` is BasicControls.xml's -- StaticPopup shim, not transcribed (see the header). if ( message ) then message("Invalid money type: "..type) end return end this.info = info this.moneyType = type local frameName = this:GetName() if ( info.canPickup ) then getglobal(frameName.."GoldButton"):EnableMouse(true) getglobal(frameName.."SilverButton"):EnableMouse(true) getglobal(frameName.."CopperButton"):EnableMouse(true) else getglobal(frameName.."GoldButton"):EnableMouse(false) getglobal(frameName.."SilverButton"):EnableMouse(false) getglobal(frameName.."CopperButton"):EnableMouse(false) end
MoneyFrame_UpdateMoney() end
-- l.164-175: re-read the number from the type and repaint. `this` again. function MoneyFrame_UpdateMoney() if ( this.info ) then local money = this.info.UpdateFunc() MoneyFrame_Update(this:GetName(), money) -- ref l.169-171 also drives the coin-pickup frame while one is open. `hasPickup` is -- only ever set by the templates' OnClick, which is guarded off (see the header), so -- this branch is unreachable today rather than removed. if ( this.hasPickup == 1 and UpdateCoinPickupFrame ) then UpdateCoinPickupFrame(money) end else if ( message ) then message("Error moneyType not set") end end end
-- The button's laid-out text width. The reference calls `Button:GetTextWidth()` (l.202 and -- kin); our Button has no such method, but the `<ButtonText name="$parentText">` FontString -- the templates below name does carry `GetStringWidth`, which measures the same string with -- the same font object. Falls back to 0 when the label has not resolved (headless, no atlas), -- which leaves the coin at exactly its icon width — the same shape, without the digits. local function moneyButtonTextWidth(buttonName) local text = getglobal(buttonName.."Text") if ( not text or not text.GetStringWidth ) then return 0 end return text:GetStringWidth() or 0 end
-- l.177-270: THE PAINTER. Splits a copper amount into the three denominations, sizes each coin -- to its own digits + icon, and then — if the type collapses — hides the leading zeros and -- re-chains what is left so the group packs tight and the frame reports its true width. -- -- Note that this one takes a frame NAME, not `this`: it is the only entry point in the family -- an owner can call about a frame that is not the one currently dispatching (`MoneyFrame_Update -- (frameName, money)` is how an addon paints a STATIC frame it just filled). function MoneyFrame_Update(frameName, money) local frame = getglobal(frameName) local info = frame.info if ( not info ) then if ( message ) then message("Error moneyType not set") end end
-- Breakdown the money into denominations local gold = floor(money / (COPPER_PER_SILVER * SILVER_PER_GOLD)) local silver = floor((money - (gold * COPPER_PER_SILVER * SILVER_PER_GOLD)) / COPPER_PER_SILVER) local copper = mod(money, COPPER_PER_SILVER)
local goldButton = getglobal(frameName.."GoldButton") local silverButton = getglobal(frameName.."SilverButton") local copperButton = getglobal(frameName.."CopperButton")
local iconWidth = MONEY_ICON_WIDTH local spacing = MONEY_BUTTON_SPACING if ( frame.small ) then iconWidth = MONEY_ICON_WIDTH_SMALL spacing = MONEY_BUTTON_SPACING_SMALL end
-- Set values for each denomination goldButton:SetText(gold) goldButton:SetWidth(moneyButtonTextWidth(frameName.."GoldButton") + iconWidth) goldButton:Show() silverButton:SetText(silver) silverButton:SetWidth(moneyButtonTextWidth(frameName.."SilverButton") + iconWidth) silverButton:Show() copperButton:SetText(copper) copperButton:SetWidth(moneyButtonTextWidth(frameName.."CopperButton") + iconWidth) copperButton:Show()
-- Store how much money the frame is displaying frame.staticMoney = money
-- If not collapsable don't need to continue if ( not info.collapse ) then return end
local width = iconWidth local showLowerDenominations, truncateCopper if ( gold > 0 ) then width = width + goldButton:GetWidth() if ( info.showSmallerCoins ) then showLowerDenominations = 1 end if ( info.truncateSmallCoins ) then truncateCopper = 1 end else goldButton:Hide() end
if ( silver > 0 or showLowerDenominations ) then -- Exception if showLowerDenominations and fixedWidth if ( showLowerDenominations and info.fixedWidth ) then silverButton:SetWidth(COIN_BUTTON_WIDTH) end
width = width + silverButton:GetWidth() goldButton:SetPoint("RIGHT", frameName.."SilverButton", "LEFT", spacing, 0) if ( goldButton:IsVisible() ) then width = width - spacing end if ( info.showSmallerCoins ) then showLowerDenominations = 1 end else silverButton:Hide() goldButton:SetPoint("RIGHT", frameName.."SilverButton", "RIGHT", 0, 0) end
-- Used if we're not showing lower denominations if ( (copper > 0 or showLowerDenominations or info.showSmallerCoins == "Backpack") and not truncateCopper) then -- Exception if showLowerDenominations and fixedWidth if ( showLowerDenominations and info.fixedWidth ) then copperButton:SetWidth(COIN_BUTTON_WIDTH) end
width = width + copperButton:GetWidth() silverButton:SetPoint("RIGHT", frameName.."CopperButton", "LEFT", spacing, 0) if ( silverButton:IsVisible() ) then width = width - spacing end else copperButton:Hide() silverButton:SetPoint("RIGHT", frameName.."CopperButton", "RIGHT", 0, 0) end
frame:SetWidth(width) end
-- l.272-346: a NO-OP in 1.12 — the reference's whole body is inside a `--[[ ]]` block, an -- earlier painter that MoneyFrame_Update replaced. Kept because the name is in the shipped -- client's `_G` and an addon that calls it gets exactly this there: nothing. function RefreshMoneyFrame(frameName, money, small, collapse, showSmallerCoins) end
-- l.348-356, verbatim: recolour the DIGITS (the coin icons keep their own texture) — how the -- reference reddens a price you cannot afford. function SetMoneyFrameColor(frameName, r, g, b) local goldButton = getglobal(frameName.."GoldButton") local silverButton = getglobal(frameName.."SilverButton") local copperButton = getglobal(frameName.."CopperButton")
goldButton:SetTextColor(r, g, b) silverButton:SetTextColor(r, g, b) copperButton:SetTextColor(r, g, b) end

Scripts.OnClick: local parent = this:GetParent() if ( OpenCoinPickupFrame ) then OpenCoinPickupFrame(1, MoneyTypeInfo[parent.moneyType].UpdateFunc(), parent) parent.hasPickup = 1 end
local parent = this:GetParent() if ( OpenCoinPickupFrame ) then OpenCoinPickupFrame(COPPER_PER_SILVER, MoneyTypeInfo[parent.moneyType].UpdateFunc(), parent) parent.hasPickup = 1 end
local parent = this:GetParent() if ( OpenCoinPickupFrame ) then OpenCoinPickupFrame(COPPER_PER_GOLD, MoneyTypeInfo[parent.moneyType].UpdateFunc(), parent) parent.hasPickup = 1 end

Scripts.OnHide: if ( this.hasPickup == 1 and CoinPickupFrame ) then CoinPickupFrame:Hide() this.hasPickup = 0 end

local parent = this:GetParent() if ( OpenCoinPickupFrame ) then OpenCoinPickupFrame(COPPER_PER_SILVER, MoneyTypeInfo[parent.moneyType].UpdateFunc(), parent) parent.hasPickup = 1 end
local parent = this:GetParent() if ( OpenCoinPickupFrame ) then OpenCoinPickupFrame(COPPER_PER_GOLD, MoneyTypeInfo[parent.moneyType].UpdateFunc(), parent) parent.hasPickup = 1 end
